input_file.description: Path to input file; if empty, read from stdin

table_attributes.description: List of attributes to include in <table> tag (e.g., ["border=1", "cellpadding=5"])

preamble.description:
HTML text inserted before the table (e.g., '

Table data:

')

cells.description: List of cell definitions; each defines a row/column and optional attributes and content. Order matters for relative addressing semantics in freetable internals (though Jinja2 does not interpret relative expressions). Used in template as ({{ cell.row }},{{ cell.col }}). Each entry must include at least 'row' and 'col' as string expressions (e.g., "1", "*", "+", "1-3"). "content" and "options" are optional. "location" is for comment only and should match human-readable coordinates like "row 1, col 2" for debugging purposes only (not used by freetable).

comment.description: If true, insert comments before every cell to point its location. Corresponds to the -c/--comment option.

no_nbsp.description: If true, do not insert non-breaking spaces in empty cells for lowered-3D appearance. Corresponds to the -b/--no-nbsp option.

warning.description: If true, print a warning before each generated table that you should not change it. Corresponds to the -w/--warning option.

location.description: If true, substitute <row> and <col> flags inside table with correct cell's location. Corresponds to the -l/--location option.

macro.description: Use macro processor to process cells content. Corresponds to the -m/--macro option. Default is 'm4'.
